title: Heranwachsende angegriffen - Polizei Berlin sucht Zeuginnen und Zeugen

extraction.summaryEn: Two unknown attackers assaulted a 19-year-old woman and a 19-year-old man in Friedrichshain, causing abrasions and cuts. The attackers allegedly shouted right-wing extremist slogans, and the case is handled by the State Protection unit.
